directions.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE premium website brand-direction board, landscape 16:10, as an elite agency art director. This is a visual theme proposal for a new web development, booking systems, automation and AI agents studio serving UK businesses and Indian manufacturers, with aspirations to become a software company. Brand name not finalized: use only the temporary wordmark "STUDIO". Show an exceptional, sophisticated 3D website concept that could become a memorable Instagram or YouTube website showcase. Keep it believable as a website, with readable front-facing HTML-like text and a photoreal 3D hero object. Custom asymmetric disciplined grid: top two-thirds a very large desktop browser homepage hero preview, lower third three calm panels for typography specimen, five palette swatches, and an alternate mobile/homepage detail. Sparse typography, generous negative space, precise alignment, thin rules, tiny index details. Hero navigation "Work", "Services", "About" and "Book a call". Hero headline exactly "Better websites. Smarter business." Hero supporting line exactly "Websites, booking systems, automation and AI." CTA "Book a free call". No fabricated metrics, customer logos, testimonials, badges or awards. Avoid stock people, robots, meaningless blobs, rainbow gradients, fake dense UI, game-world visual clichés, glass cards everywhere. This is a static reference for future live 3D; make materials and lighting extraordinary. DIRECTION 01: "KINETIC CHROME". Mood: precision engineering, premium creative technology, highly cinematic. Main hero charcoal black with restrained cobalt blue, oversized off-white geometric sans headline left, huge sculptural polished chromium folded rectangular portal / modular frame right, subtle cobalt emissive seam, physically realistic reflections and black studio floor. The frame symbolizes building a website and connecting intelligent workflows, with only one hero object. Palette five solid blocks labeled #0B0D10, #171B22, #F4F6F8, #316BFF, #A5AFBF. Title panel "01 / KINETIC CHROME". Typography specimen label "Space Grotesk + Manrope", specimen "Built with precision." in sharp geometric grotesk style. Browser preview feels like a contemporary high-end interactive 3D engineering studio, calm clean navigation, no neon cyberpunk. Mobile detail carries same composition and simple CTA. Main text flat and readable, chrome 3D deeply sculptural.
